briefings.title: CVE-2015-5477: ISC BIND actively exploited
briefings.excerpt: ISC BIND contains a data processing errors vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to cause a denial of service via TKEY queries.

briefings.title: CVE-2016-3081: Apache Struts actively exploited
briefings.excerpt: Apache Struts contains a command injection vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via method:prefix when Dynamic Method Invocation is enabled.
